name: Just-In-Time Activation Extended
description: Notifies the identity whose Just-In-Time activation window was extended that the active JIT window has been extended.
subject: Your Just-In-Time access for ${entitlementName} has been extended
body:
Just-In-Time Activation Extended

Dear $__recipient.name,

Your Just-In-Time activation window has been extended. The details are below.

Entitlement: ${entitlementName}

Additional duration: ${extensionDuration}

#if($activationUrl)

You may return to $__global.productName here to see your options for extending or deactivating this entitlement early.

#end

Please contact ${ownerName} if you have any questions.

Thank you for using $__global.productName.
